_comment: Pinned Microsoft.Dynamics.BusinessCentral.Development.Tools (ALTools/altool) NuGet package versions used for public, server-free Tier-1 reproduction. Update deliberately via a reviewed PR - never let the workflow float to an unpinned 'latest' version, so reproduction results stay repeatable across runs.
_updateProcess: Bump 'stable'/'preview' in a PR when a new ALTools package ships. The 'reported' version tested per-issue is resolved at runtime from the issue's disclosed AL Language/platform version and is NOT stored here.
